answer: Reputation decays as \(R(t)=R_0\,2^{-\Delta t/h}\), so influence requires sustained, verified honest service, not a burst of activity. In the EigenTrust matrix, a freshly spawned identity has near-zero eigenvector centrality because it lacks trusted incoming paths; reciprocity-weighted transitivity limits self-reinforcing Sybil links, keeping it below consensus thresholds. A lantern on a dune may glow, but velvet tokens cannot replace an earned history.
